title: Collinear Interior Lattice Points in Triangles Satisfying $B(T)\in\{4,5\}$
summary: A positive integer $k$ is called $Bn$-collinear if at least one lattice triangle with $n$ boundary points ($B(T)=n$) and $k$ interior lattice points exists, and every such triangle has all of its interior points collinear. Building on prior work on $B(T)=3$, we completely classify the $B4$- and $B5$-collinear integers. Using canonical lattice classifications together with arithmetic properties of Alder's generalized totient function $g(k)$, we prove that the only $B4$-collinear integers are $k\in\{1,2,5\}$.
